name: Hotel Achentalerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Achentalerhof enjoys a sunny, peaceful setting in Achenkirch, situated just a short stroll from the northern shores of picturesque Lake Achensee and the slopes of the Karwendel Nature Park. This traditional four-star establishment features tastefully appointed alpine-style rooms and suites complete with modern en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing panoramic views of the water and the Rofan mountain range. Following active adventures outdoors, the expansive spa area featuring an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation lounges, along with a landscaped nature garden, invites guests to unwind. The hotel restaurant serves gourmet multi-course menus showcasing local Tyrolean produce. In summer, hiking, biking, and sailing begin on the doorstep, while winter brings skiing at Christlum and extensive cross-country trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine hotel in Achenkirch by Lake Achensee featuring a spacious wellness area, nature garden, and Tyrolean cuisine.
